title: Himeji & Kobe in 3 Days — Himeji Castle, Shoshazan, Kobe
subtitle: Himeji Castle, Shoshazan and Kobe: three days in and out of Kansai
summary: Three days, two cities: Himeji Castle and Kōko-en Garden, Engyō-ji on Mt. Shosha, and on the last day Kobe Animal Kingdom and Sannomiya. You fly in and out of Kansai Airport. Osaka has its own template, so it is not repeated here. The Naruto whirlpools, the Akashi Kaikyō Bridge, Uonotana Market and the Kitano Ijinkan district sit in the alternates.

What changed and what was cut

Days 5 and 6 of the travelogue covered Osaka (Namba Yasaka Shrine, Tsūtenkaku, Umeda) and the Kobe harbour area. Osaka has its own template, so this one keeps only Himeji, Shoshazan, Kobe Animal Kingdom and Sannomiya.
Kōko-en and the night view from Himeji Station were not visited in the travelogue but are on the way, so they were added. The travelogue did not go to Himeji Municipal Zoo, so it is left out.
Route

This template is a Himeji and Kobe trip in and out of Kansai Airport: day 1 from the airport to Himeji, day 2 Shoshazan and Himeji Castle, day 3 Kobe Animal Kingdom and Sannomiya, then back to the airport in the afternoon.
Kobe is only Animal Kingdom and Sannomiya. For Motomachi, Meriken Park and Harborland, see the Kyoto–Osaka–Kobe template.
Getting between the airport and the city

Outbound: Limited Express Haruka from Kansai Airport to Shin-Osaka takes about 50 min, then the Sanyō Shinkansen to Himeji about 30 min. With the change it is about 2 hours and around ¥5,400 in all (old data).
Outbound alternative: a direct airport bus to Himeji Station takes about 1.5–2 hours and costs about ¥3,400–3,700. Departures are few, so check the bus company's timetable.
Return: take the airport limousine bus from Sannomiya to Kansai Airport, about 65–75 min and about ¥2,200. Choose a flight that leaves after 19:30.
Highlights

Shoshazan Engyō-ji: the donation does not include the shuttle bus. The bus takes about 5 min, while walking up takes about 20 min (the travelogue suggests spending the money on the bus to save your legs). Allow at least 2 hours to see everything.
Himeji Castle: you take your shoes off inside, and the steep stairs often have a queue. If the weather is bad, switch to an indoor plan.
A combined ticket for Kōko-en and Himeji Castle costs ¥2,600. Check the official site for how long it stays valid.
There are not many shops around Himeji Station and they close early in the evening. Tax-free hours at drugstores usually end earlier than their opening hours.
The penguin feeding and the hands-on animal areas at Kobe Animal Kingdom need a numbered ticket. Pick it up first thing after you enter.
From Sannomiya, take the Port Liner toward Kobe Airport to get to Animal Kingdom. The train toward Kita-futō turns back at Kita-futō.
Pacing
Days 1 and 3 are heavy on travel because of the trips to and from Kansai Airport.
The template is based on November, so sunset and opening hours change with the season.
Other
Carry enough yen in cash. Register on Visit Japan Web before you arrive: https://www.vjw.digital.go.jp/main/#/vjwpco001

notes.title: Trip overview: how the 3 days run
paragraphs: In and out of Kansai Airport, with the first two nights based in Himeji and the last day moved to Kobe, ending with the airport bus from Sannomiya in the evening. The transport plan is simple: mostly walking in Himeji, a bus plus ropeway up Shoshazan, and trains plus the Port Liner in Kobe.

Day 1: land at the airport around noon, take the limited express and Shinkansen to Himeji, visit {@d1-03} after lunch, then have dinner by the station and photograph the castle at night from the deck at the north exit.
Day 2: the morning goes to {@d2-01} up on Shoshazan, then {@d2-03} after lunch, and the afternoon is for shopping at Piole and the streets around Himeji Station.
Day 3: JR to Sannomiya, then the Port Liner to {@d3-01} to pet the capybaras, Kobe beef for lunch, a wander through Sannomiya Center-gai, and the airport bus back to Kansai Airport.
Where to sleep: two nights in a row at Toyoko Inn Himeji Station Shinkansen North Exit; on day 3 you check out and head to Kobe, so there is no further stay.

Getting around: from the airport to Himeji, take the Haruka limited express and change to the Sanyo Shinkansen, about 2 hours with the transfer (a direct airport bus also runs, with few departures); from Himeji Station to Shoshazan, take the Shinki Bus and then the ropeway; Himeji to Sannomiya is the JR Special Rapid; from Sannomiya the Port Liner toward Kobe Airport reaches the zoo; the way back is the airport limousine bus from Sannomiya, about 65 to 75 minutes, so choose a flight that leaves after 19:30. Check the latest timetables before you go.

Who it suits: anyone who wants Himeji Castle plus an easy animal-petting day, solo or in a group of two or three. Days 1 and 3 are heavy on transport, and day 2 has a mountain path and steep stairs, so wear comfortable shoes.
